The garment can be an unworn object. A role's human-only applicability or another role's actor-owned fact must not become an intrinsic requirement that creates a wearer or rejects the existing garment role. Review object/actor/context owners independently, including product-domain exclusions in garment_detail and attire_context. The body names fungi, while the current content.kind includes plant and macro. Do not treat plant metadata as biological truth. Resolve the native taxonomy/eligibility and all dependent consumers with explicit reviewed before/after evidence.

Adding precise role facts to existing coarse or empty property metadata can narrow a previously conservative lock scope. Audit each effect/owner refinement against frozen intent, local and whole-scene locks, positive and negative applications; retaining the old dimension name alone does not prove equivalent protection. Source 958 applies backlight to haze, which must not override a separately frozen actor-lighting setup. Resolve source-to-receiver scope rather than relying on a free-form light target label.

Before removing a role link or changing a referenced candidate to diagnostic, resolve every bundle/profile/member dependency that addresses its existing binding. Preserve candidate identity, conditions, ordering and branch semantics; do not redirect to an arbitrary replacement role or retain an operating legacy adapter.

Square 1:1 and vertical 9:16 are explicit aspect ratios; platform_frame facets claim a safe area that their positive text does not state. Audit facet routing, role qualification and final metadata so these facets cannot substitute for actual UI/crop-safe placement evidence. Preserve the valid format meaning.

A camera pictured as the subject or a visible prop is distinct from the recording camera. A light-producing device class does not prove that the device is switched on. Conversely, virtual camera/operator support references must not create an extra visible actor. Native qualification must bind each owner and usage separately, reject wrong-owner intent changes and account for emitted state before using an object as an illumination cue.

Full-cue obligations survive positive fact extraction: no readable lettering is not no lettering; non-explicit presentation is not a license to add explicit content; an explicitly adult subject cannot bypass an existing minor/age intent through another selected role. These constraints need owned native guards and counterfactual verification, not just rationale text or a positive role list.
